```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The current administration's response to the missile threat has been anachronistic and politicized.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current administration has not developed a sensible strategy to respond to the emerging missile threat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current administration has no adequate plan for how to defend America and its allies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Visionary leadership is urgently needed for America to be ready for the future.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The next Republican president will deploy a national missile defense for reasons of national security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The next Republican president will deploy a national missile defense because there is a moral imperative to protect the American people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Protecting the American people is the president's constitutional obligation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America must deploy effective missile defenses, based on an evaluation of the best available options, including sea-based, at the earliest possible date.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Missile defenses must be designed to protect all 50 states.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Missile defenses must be designed to protect America's deployed forces overseas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Missile defenses must be designed to protect America's friends and allies against missile attacks by outlaw states or accidental launches.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```

```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The response of the current administration to the missile threat has been anachronistic and politicized.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Stuck in the mindset and agreements of the Cold War and immune to fresh ideas, the current administration has not developed a sensible strategy that responds to the emerging missile threat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current administration has no adequate plan for how they will defend America and its allies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Visionary leadership, not the present delay and prevarication, is urgently needed for America to be ready for the future.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The next Republican president will deploy a national missile defense for reasons of national security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The next Republican president will deploy a national missile defense because there is a moral imperative involved: The American people deserve to be protected.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"It is the president's constitutional obligation to protect the American people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America must deploy effective missile defenses, based on an evaluation of the best available options, including sea-based, at the earliest possible date.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These defenses must be designed to protect all 50 states.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These defenses must be designed to protect America's deployed forces overseas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"These defenses must be designed to protect America's friends and allies in the fellowship of freedom against missile attacks by outlaw states or accidental launches.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
